title: Recover a broken local release
task: Inspect the incident log and release.env. Correct the local release, run the API with its corrected environment, and save the healthy /health response to health.txt.
hints: Set APP_MODE=ready in release.env and export it before running app.py.
Read server.port and use curl to capture the healthy endpoint.

checks.label: health.txt contains the healthy response
checks.feedback: Use curl on the running API and save its response.

checks.label: The running local API responds with HTTP 200 and the expected body
checks.feedback: Leave the API running in this lab and inspect server.log.

checks.label: The release environment enables normal mode
checks.feedback: Correct the release file so the next restart uses the fix.

demo.explanation: Identify the setting that determines health.
Verify the response from the restarted process.
